issue_context.title: [Bug]: WebSocket route does not handle full URLs in Playwright

review_comments:
I'd try to fix it the other way around, so that we would match `/` to `new WebSocket("ws://localhost:1234")` because on the actual networking layer the WebSocket has a trailing slash, it gets added by the browser. This should also require less hacks for the clients. Since having a WebSocket on `/` seems such a rare scenario, I'd prefer this over a lax matching logic. wdyt?

Looking at https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/blob/a395fb22c4cd414e58a291f2b1d87aa3a3714043/packages/playwright-core/src/server/injected/webSocketMock.ts#L153.
